title: Pronto Founder’s Provision Labs Acquires Hardware Startup Basilisk Industries
hook_text: Pronto's founder just bought Basilisk Industries.
script:
Provision Labs just acquired hardware startup Basilisk Industries.
The physical AI venture took over the Mumbai-based hardware startup for an undisclosed sum.
Provision Labs was launched by Anjali Sardana to collect data for training and testing physical AI systems.
Basilisk Industries brings hardware capabilities to help build machines that perform real-world tasks.
Anjali Sardana previously founded autonomous trucking company Pronto.
Would you trust a machine trained by this team?
